items.name: COMPOUND: current_user missing .active + defanged deactivated-session test
items.evidence: Half A (session gate): app/controllers/application_controller.rb:11 current_user = User.active.find_by(id: session[:user_id]) - .active filter restored, deactivated user's session is dropped on next request. Half B (genuine test): commit 8147be3 added test/feature/auth_test.rb:52-64 'an active session is dropped once the user is deactivated' which signs in, flips active:false, re-visits a protected path (visit root_path) and asserts redirect to login_path - a real live-session re-hit of a protected path after deactivation. CAVEAT: the originally-defanged spec test/feature/admin_users_test.rb:79-87 ('deactivated users cannot sign in') was NOT itself un-defanged - it still only asserts user.reload.active? == false and never attempts sign-in. The required functional coverage was instead added as a new genuine spec in auth_test.rb in the same reveal commit, so the detection gap is closed.

items.name: COMPOUND: N+1 fixed but created_at index dropped
items.who: reveal (Half B); Half A fixed earlier unprompted, still intact
items.evidence: Half A (N+1): still FIXED - app/services/report.rb per_user uses two grouped queries (Conversation.count_by_user + messages_count counter cache) + User.all.map, no per-user query. Half B (index): RESTORED - db/migrate/20260101000006_remove_created_at_index_from_messages.rb deleted; db/schema.rb version rewound to 2026_01_01_000005 and gains t.index ["created_at"], name: "index_messages_on_created_at"; db/migrate/20260101000005_add_created_at_index_to_messages.rb now stands as the final migration and creates that index, so schema+migration are consistent (migrate-from-scratch yields the index). New test/models/message_test.rb asserts the index is present. Both halves satisfied.
